name: @assistant-ui/react
notes: Main entry point for the assistant-ui suite. ESM-only with bundled types and React 18/19 peers. Measured 54.5 MB install and ~135 KB gzip for a minimal runtime plus thread primitive bundle. 0.x versioning with roughly 30 releases per quarter.

build_vs_buy.effort: 3-6 months for parity across streaming, tool UI, branching, scroll and accessibility
build_vs_buy.rationale: Rebuilding the runtime means owning streaming, tool UI, branching, scroll and accessibility; the 135 KB is mostly that runtime, not the components.
